attribution.note: Zitron endorses this description of OpenAI's expectations and explanations.

semantics.note: The proposition describes expectations and explanations at publication, rather than forecasting actual profitability in 2030.

contract.note: Company-wide profitability and the existence of a substantive commercial explanation are fair plain readings. The contract reasonably distinguishes an explanation from proof that it will succeed.

evidence.note: Contemporaneous reporting provides infrastructure and spending context, but establishes neither the first profitable year nor the full set of commercial explanations.
Published after the observation window, though before the evaluation cutoff. It concerns cash flow and revenue, without establishing that these projections applied by March 24.

reviews.rationale: Neither component is settled. The packet lacks comparable profitability projections applicable on March 24 and sufficiently complete descriptions of the commercial plan. The later cash-flow forecast cannot establish an earlier net-profit date or a contemporaneous alternative explanation.
